Container.Name: unfacet
Container.Overview: Unfacet turns STL, 3MF and OBJ meshes into editable STEP solids. It recognises planes, cylinders, cones, spheres, tori and ISO threads in the triangles and rebuilds them as true CAD geometry with OpenCascade. Web UI for fixing faces, resizing holes (M2–M16, clearance, tap drill, plastic or a real cut thread), checking deviation and STEP validity, filling cavities and closing mesh gaps. Sessions live in memory; no appdata is needed.

Config.Name: Max upload (MB)
Config.Description: Largest mesh file accepted. Raise your reverse proxy's upload limit to match.

Config.Name: Parallel jobs
Config.Description: Analyses and exports that can run at the same time. Each uses one CPU core while working.

Config.Name: CPU workers
Config.Description: Processes used for multi-core recognition and STEP building. 0 uses every core; 1 turns it off. Lower it to leave cores free for other containers.

Config.Name: Session timeout (minutes)
Config.Description: Idle sessions are dropped after this many minutes.

Config.Name: Max sessions
Config.Description: The oldest session is dropped beyond this number.
